input.headline: Backend Engineer at Corvid Logistics | Java, Spring, Postgres
input.about: I've been a backend engineer at Corvid Logistics for about three years. I work on the shipment tracking services and the APIs our warehouse partners use. Before that I did a bootcamp and worked in customer support, which honestly taught me a lot about how users actually break things. I like boring, reliable systems and good on-call docs. Open to senior backend roles.
